name: The Mane House
description: The Mane House is a modern beauty salon for precision cuts, dimensional color and balayage, blowouts, extensions, and treatments — a calm, elevated space where every mane gets the care it deserves.

hero.title: Every mane deserves a home.
hero.subtitle: Precision cuts, dimensional color, balayage, blowouts, and extensions in a calm, elevated salon — book your visit to The Mane House today.

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Lead Stylist
stylists.bio: The founder of The Mane House created a calm, elevated salon where every client's hair gets thoughtful, expert care — from precision cuts and dimensional color to extensions and healthy-hair treatments.

reviews.name: Rachel G.
reviews.text: The Mane House is my happy place. Beautiful salon, beautiful color, and such a calm experience.

reviews.name: Olivia N.
reviews.text: Best balayage I've ever had — soft, blended, and it grew out perfectly.

reviews.name: Chris M.
reviews.text: Sharp, clean cut and a really welcoming team. Booking again for sure.

reviews.name: Emma D.
reviews.text: My tape-ins blend flawlessly. They really take their time and care about your hair.
